lines.text: Every home has a departure. Every single morning.
Seven fifty-two. School, work, the bus. Everyone has to make it.
But people misjudge time. In a classic study, only three in ten finished when they said they would.
At home, it compounds. One long shower, and the whole family is late.
A timer doesn't know your eight-minute shower takes twelve. And it can't answer the question that matters: will we make it, and if not, what changes?
So we built Doorbound: a live departure board for the family morning, on Alexa Plus.
Alexa, start the school run. We leave in forty minutes.
School run started. Everyone is on time. Leave at 7:52, in 40 minutes. Isha is the tightest, with about a 9 in 10 chance.
Every person gets a row: what they're doing, the minutes left, and their real chance of making it.
I'm done with the lunches.
Pack lunches done. Dad is on to unload dishwasher, about 11 minutes.
Every 'done' is a real duration. It learns how long your mornings really take.
Alexa, Isha's still in the shower. Ten more minutes, she says.
Isha's chance drops to forty-eight percent.
Re-routed: Isha has breakfast to go and Dad takes over pack bag for Isha. Everyone still leaves at 7:52, and Isha is back on track, with about a 9 in 10 chance.
It searched every change the family allowed and chose the smallest one that works. Isha is back to ninety-two percent.
Alexa, we're out the door!
School run done, on time. Have a good day.
Out the door at seven forty-nine. Three minutes to spare.
Under the hood: an MCP server with seventeen tools, one for each thing a family says. And the board is an MCP App.
Every step is a probability distribution, learned from your own mornings. The re-planner is an exact search, checked against brute force, in a fifth of a millisecond.
When it says eighty-five percent, it happens about eighty-five percent of the time, across forty thousand simulated mornings. A hundred tests and the official MCP conformance suite back it up.
With no Alexa device, we built a simulator that is a real MCP client and app host. The board you saw is the real product.
Doorbound. Every morning, on time.
